rows.label: tlk70000001_02_msg0001
rows.name:
The Gargoyle attack was the biggest
incident since the district began, mo.
No wonder everyone's stunned, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000001_02_msg0002
rows.name:
But if we just stand there, the shops
will never reopen, mo. Business would
be ruined, mo!!

rows.label: tlk70000001_02_msg0003
rows.name:
That's when the Chamber of Commerce
members stepped up, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000001_02_msg0004
rows.name:
Cleaning, repairs, handing out food...
Adults and children found what they
could do and got to work, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000001_02_msg0005
rows.name:
You could call it an all-out effort by
the whole shopping district, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000001_02_msg0006
rows.name:
Morumo worked hard too, mo. If I
didn't get results here, I'd disgrace
the Chamber chairman's name, mo!!

rows.label: tlk70000001_02_msg0007
rows.name:
Thanks to that, we managed to recover
at an incredible pace, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000001_02_msg0008
rows.name:
Everyone worked so, so hard, mo! I'm
still excited, mooo.
